coverage.scope: The depicted named cast of the current Book I visual novel. Future-book characters and unnamed crowd figures are outside this catalog.

guidance.authority: The current manuscript, established wiki details and author clarifications guide identity. Exact garment cuts, palettes, poses and newly drawn hidden surfaces are production design choices.
guidance.age: The author’s direction is for a naturally human appearance below roughly 100. This does not assign an exact age to any Book I adult or import later-life biography aging into earlier scenes.
guidance.stage: Both early and later friendship keys remain childhood. Match wardrobe to activity and chronology, and choose expressions for the scene rather than treating a neutral key pose as every performance.
guidance.lighting: Preserve identity, complexion and iris pigment under shared scene lighting. These sheets do not require every scene to use their studio light.
guidance.scale: Sheets are fitted independently to their pages. Use established relative stature and familiar size ordering when composing a shared scene.

characters.name: Maia
characters.canon: Warm brown skin; amber-green eyes; silver-streaked dark curls and braids; tall and slender.
characters.production: Blue-teal and ochre home clothes, gardening workwear and small botanical ornaments.
characters.stage_note: Vital adult during Calista’s childhood; later-life biography details are not an opening-scene age assignment.

characters.name: Arin
characters.canon: Pale freckles; blue eyes; cropped auburn hair; lean, capable build.
characters.production: Close sides and short textured hair distinguish Arin from Sage; workshop apron and practical clothes.
characters.stage_note: Earlier adult in First Breath, then the same adult during childhood. Undated injuries are not added by assumption.

characters.name: Selene
characters.canon: Deep bronze skin; white hair; violet eyes; petite stature and long musician’s fingers.
characters.production: Plum and teal clothes, a graceful narrow face and restrained listening gestures.
characters.stage_note: Genetic white hair begins early in adulthood; it does not make the childhood parent elderly.

characters.name: Dorian
characters.canon: Rich dark skin; brown eyes; glasses; broad shoulders; mixed black and gray hair.
characters.production: Teal sleeveless coat, close curls, modest silver and a notebook held in his anatomical left hand.
characters.stage_note: Childhood-era adult; avoid importing the later biography’s mostly silver beard or pronounced stoop.

characters.name: Sage
characters.canon: Warm tan, rosy freckled skin; gray eyes; short sandy hair; soft round features and medium build.
characters.production: Calmer wavy crop, rounder cheeks and soft jaw; green and russet everyday clothes.
characters.stage_note: Adult androgynous identity stays clear through warmth, attention and concern.

characters.name: Calista
characters.canon: Light olive complexion; blue eyes; freckles across nose and cheeks; chestnut hair.
characters.production: Early overalls and later pocket vest preserve selected play/exploration outfits; home, festival and painting clothes remain separate variants.
characters.stage_note: Both sheets depict childhood. Later begins with shared projects and remains before Book II’s late teens.

characters.name: Cassia
characters.canon: Rich umber skin; deep green eyes; long chestnut waves; slender child; subtle left-wrist birthmark.
characters.production: Plum and ochre clothes, loose trousers and story notebook; preserve accepted soft facial midtones and lip edges.
characters.stage_note: Both sheets depict childhood; the later sadness portrait references mourning, while turnarounds use exploration clothes.

characters.name: Joren
characters.canon: Sturdy fair-ruddy boy; blond hair; blue eyes; small front-tooth gap and healing knee scrapes.
characters.production: Early rust overshirt/shorts and later teal overshirt/trousers; slightly taller and sturdier than the girls.
characters.stage_note: Both sheets depict his living childhood. The sadness study is ordinary disappointment; he does not appear alive after his death.

characters.name: Kael
characters.canon: Deep warm brown skin; dark tousled hair; gold-hazel eyes; tall and lean for his age.
characters.production: Practical adventure clothes, alert posture and an asymmetric, youthful grin.
characters.stage_note: Older child relative to Calista, with youthful limbs rather than an adult physique; no exact age gap is assigned.

characters.name: Lyra
characters.canon: Golden-tan olive skin; golden freckles and curls; green eyes; small, sprightly build.
characters.production: Natural child face construction keeps the curious gaze and recognizable golden curls; existing play clothes remain.
characters.stage_note: Younger and visibly smaller than her siblings. Frightened or wet scenes require the appropriate performance and staging.

characters.name: Thalia
characters.canon: Serene bearing; flowing practical clothes; deep green eyes shared with Cassia.
characters.production: Selected face, complexion and clothing palette are production choices; listening and explanation remain distinct moods.
characters.stage_note: Adult during Book I family visits. Calm demeanor does not require a permanent smile.

characters.name: Lyron
characters.canon: Tall, gentle adult; salt-and-pepper hair; hazel eyes.
characters.production: Revised blue-gray asymmetric wrap tunic, plain brown trousers and soft shoes; selected face remains gentle and distinct from Kaleb.
characters.stage_note: Adult during Book I. The current garment follows the author’s targeted wardrobe refinement; older collared drafts are not shown.

characters.name: Soren
characters.role: Emergency response and safety systems designer
characters.canon: Cropped hair; sharp blue eyes; nimble hands; practical working clothes with localized grease or oil marks.
characters.production: Compact working silhouette, focused expression and precise gestures; exact hair color and overall palette are selected design choices.
characters.stage_note: Adult during Book I, with work focus distinct from later grief.

characters.name: Kaleb
characters.canon: Tall, rugged adult; weathered face; gray-streaked brown hair; golden-brown eyes.
characters.production: Irregular longer hair, heavier brow and grounded posture distinguish him from Lyron; coat and scarf are production choices.
characters.stage_note: Everyday engagement and restrained memorial grief are separate performances.

characters.name: Shadow
characters.canon: Sleek black coat; green eyes; one notched ear and a slightly crooked tail tip.
characters.production: Selected design locates the notch on her anatomical left ear; one slender tail remains consistent through each view.
characters.stage_note: Childhood family companion. Smaller than Barkley and much larger than Nibble; no new injury history or integration hardware.

characters.name: Barkley
characters.canon: Golden retriever with golden fur, loyalty and a lively, protective presence.
characters.production: Selected honey-gold feathering, dark eyes and broad retriever muzzle; calm and gently alert head studies.
characters.stage_note: Existing adult dog design during childhood; largest of the three familiars.

characters.name: Nibble
characters.canon: Small, inquisitive rat; author-selected fluffy black/brown-and-white coat, white blaze, pink ears and mismatched eyes.
characters.production: Anatomical right eye violet, left eye coral. Left-facing profile shows coral; white hindquarters have no invented dark spot.
characters.stage_note: Shoulder-sized companion, much smaller than the cat. Large ears and expressive eyes are deliberate author design.
